cold.question: ¿Cuántos clientes tienen facturas vencidas hace más de 30 días?
cold.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 DAYS' LIMIT 100

cold.question: ¿Cuál es el monto total pagado por cada cliente?
¿Qué facturas están pendientes de pago actualmente?
cold.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoices.customer_id) AS num_invoices_overdue FROM invoices WHERE invoices.status = 'overdue' LIMIT 100

cold.question: ¿Cuáles son los clientes con mayor monto de facturas vencidas?
cold.sql: SELECT customers.full_name, SUM(invoices.amount) AS total_amount_overdue FROM invoices JOIN customers ON customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id WHERE invoices.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY customers.full_name ORDER BY total_amount_overdue DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

cold.question: ¿Qué acciones de cobranza se han hecho sobre facturas vencidas?
cold.sql: SELECT action_type FROM collection_actions WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT invoice_id FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 DAYS') LIMIT 100

cold.question: ¿Cuántos pagos parciales se registraron el último mes?
cold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_partial_payments FROM payments WHERE payment_method = 'partial' AND paid_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 MONTH') LIMIT 100

cold.question: ¿Cuál es el promedio de días entre la emisión y el pago de una factura?
cold.sql: SELECT invoices.invoice_id, payments.payment_id, payments.paid_at, invoices.issued_date, payments.amount_paid, invoices.issued_date - payments.paid_at AS days_between_issue_and_payment FROM invoices JOIN payments ON invoices.invoice_id = payments.invoice_id WHERE invoices.status = 'paid' ORDER BY days_between_issue_and_payment LIMIT 100

cold.question: ¿Qué clientes no han hecho ningún pago todavía?
cold.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS num_customers_without_payments FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON c.customer_id = p.invoice_id WHERE p.invoice_id IS NULL LIMIT 100

cold.question: ¿Cuántas facturas se emitieron por mes en el último año?
cold.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoices.customer_id) AS num_customers FROM invoices WHERE invoices.issued_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 YEAR') AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoices.issued_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoices.issued_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 100

cold.question: ¿Cuál es el método de pago más utilizado por los clientes?
cold.sql: SELECT p.payment_method, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM payments AS p GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY COUNT DESC LIMIT 1
